specs.v: Wings, leash and three chest straps (S, M, L)

description.html: The Nomoy Pet NFF-56 is a lizard leash with decorative bat-shaped wings. The set includes the wings, a leash of about 1.5 m with an adjustable clip and three chest straps in sizes S, M and L, so the harness fits lizards of different sizes. The pack labels it as a lizard accessory (Lizard Leash), and the wings give your lizard the look of a small dragon on walks. The leash lets the animal spend a little time outdoors safely, without being able to run off or hide somewhere out of reach.

It is most often used for bearded dragons, but it also suits other calm lizards of a similar build. Before buying, tell us the species and size of your lizard and we will check together whether it fits. Use the leash only while you are with the animal and never leave it on your lizard unsupervised.

description.text: Getting your lizard used to the leash

description.html: The strap should sit snugly but leave room for a finger, without pressing on the belly. First let the lizard wear the leash for a few minutes indoors until it gets used to it. Outdoors, do not pull it or lift it by the rope; the leash is there to stop the animal escaping, not to lead it.

Go out only in warm, calm weather, for short periods, and always provide shade and a place to retreat. Watch out for dogs, cats and birds of prey. Read more about bearded dragons on our bearded dragon page.
Order by phone or WhatsApp message. Delivery to your address in any town in Serbia. In Novi Sad - pickup at our workshop.
